direction: January holds absence beside belonging: an empty winter wetland, red soil under a branching tree, and an ordinary small moon. Wide charcoal water, grounded gouache earth and sparse pastel night vary scale and material. Philosophical questions and spiritual ambiguity remain text-led.

items.title: The water waits
items.rationale: The poem ends with the crane not returning. An empty winter wetland honours that unresolved absence without fabricating a sighting of the named bird or pretending to document a particular Iranian location.

review.notes: Normal-size review passes: open winter water and rooted overlapping reeds carry absence; no bird, footprints or fabricated named sighting appears. Distant reed breaks and irregular quiet reflections are plausible. Sky occupies more of the frame than initially suggested but its low-cloud light supports the mood without spectacle. Cool charcoal-watercolour edges retain an imagined rather than documentary wetland.

items.alt: A quiet winter wetland lies empty beneath a low cloudy sky, dry reeds at its edge.

items.title: Red earth, open sky
items.rationale: The speaker longs for release from institutional distance into red soil, green valleys and trees. A low earth-level view gives the ground dignity and lets a tree branch into open sky without illustrating a transformed human body.

review.notes: Normal-size review passes: red soil has weight and irregular clods, the tree grows securely into the bank, branches taper and foliage overlaps without ornamental repetition. Low viewpoint and receding valley place the reader near earth; near soil and bark are more resolved than distant greens. Broad sky prevents a crowded scene. Matte painted colour, no transformed body or invented location claim.

items.alt: Red earth beneath an ordinary branching tree overlooks a softly painted green valley.

items.title: A quiet lunar companion
items.rationale: The moon keeps an intimate vigil over unuttered thoughts. A small ordinary moon above an understated roof edge offers companionship without literal flowers, bunny ears, tears or a gigantic fantasy moon.

review.notes: Normal-size review passes: small gibbous moon stays secondary to the open indigo night and quiet roof edge. Phase shading is coherent, cloud veil does not become a theatrical nebula, and roof planes have plausible perspective. Selective pastel texture and matte darks preserve companionship without a glowing giant moon, literal face or tears. No astronomical observation or named location claimed.

items.alt: A small pale moon keeps company with an unadorned roof beneath a broad indigo sky.

text_led.rationale: The questions of oblivion and departure remain unresolved; a text-led opening avoids declaring whether the mythic boat sets sail.
Keep the spiritual yearning and difficult ambiguity in the speaker’s words; avoid a literal death, vanishing body or sentimental escape landscape.
The argument about truth, history and poetry benefits from direct reading rather than a balance, mask or courtroom cliché.
